newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end mixed in a consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end mixed in a consolidation.

text.p: Taiwan share prices closed mixed on Saturday in a consolidation, with most sectors seeing little movement amid an absence of market-moving factors, brokers said.
The weighted index, moving within a narrow range throughout Saturday's shortened session, ended down 7.08 points or 0.11 percent at 6,464.55. Turnover was an active T$45.8 billion.
The only sector to see significant action was electronics, dropping 1.07 percent on profit-taking following a rise on Friday.

Monitor giant Lite-On Technology fell 3.91 percent or T$1.80 to T$44.20. "The fall wasn't based on anything fundamental, but just investors routinely changing their holdings," said Lin Long-hsien of United Securities.

Financials, buoyed by news of Chicago Mercantile Exchange planning to list futures and options based on the Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index, rose 0.23 percent. China Trust gained T$0.50 to T$52.50 in an active trade volume of 20 million shares.
"The CME news gave major shares a little boost, but it was not an overwhelming factor," said Wang Jieh of Foremost Investment.
Brokers expect the index will remain in a tight range of between 6,400 and 6,500 on Monday. A bullish trend was seen for the longer term on foreign fund inflows, they said.
